The '''''Justice''''' was a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] in the service of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==History==
The ''Justice'' was the flagship of Commander [[Harron Tavus]], a former officer of the [[Republic Army]]'s [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces Division]] and commander of [[Havoc Squad]]. The ship was given to him by the Empire after he and hundreds of other SpecFor officers and troopers defected in [[3643 BBY]], in response to their increasing disillusionment with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The ship was named by Tavus himself, possibly an allusion to his motivations for defecting. As the ''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts were the backbone of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Armada]], the fact that such a vessel had been placed into the hands of a Republic defector suggested that the Empire held great faith in Tavus.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Justice (Trooper)}}</ref>

After [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|the Lieutenant]] who had taken command of a reformed Havoc Squad began hunting down and eliminating the defectors and their resources on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Tavus recalled his remaining allies to the ''Justice'', but his transmissions were all intercepted by Special Forces. General [[Elin Garza]], commander of the Special Forces Division, dispatched Havoc Squad to the ''Justice'' under the guise of answering Tavus' call. Their mission was to first disable the ship's hyperdrive, then proceed to the bridge and neutralize Tavus.<ref name="Valor">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Inconspicuous Valor|the ''Justice''}}</ref>

After disabling the hyperdrive and defeating [[Zora|Wraith]], the last of the Havoc traitors under Tavus' command, Havoc Squad proceeded to the bridge and defeated Tavus. General Garza then boarded with her guard troopers to take possession of the ship.<ref name="Justice">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Justice|the ''Justice''}}</ref>
